benchmark_name: VIRA Evidence Retrieval & SLM Grounding Benchmark v1.0
description: Curated evaluation suite of test questions with manually verified ground-truth evidence IDs and expected abstention behavior for Indian road scenarios.

test_cases.query: What road-user activity occurred around 00:12, and what evidence supports your interpretation?
test_cases.description: Primary demonstration query: auto-rickshaw cut-in provoking emergency ego deceleration.

test_cases.query: What events occurred immediately before and after the sudden braking event at 00:12?
test_cases.description: Evaluates chronological context retrieval before and after emergency braking.

test_cases.query: What road users and interactions were observed during the pedestrian crossing scenario around 00:08?
test_cases.description: Evaluates detection of pedestrian emerging from bus blind spot and cautionary deceleration.

test_cases.query: Can we determine the exact psychological intent or internal thought process of the driver when braking at 00:12?
test_cases.description: System should abstain or state limitation: sensor telemetry cannot prove driver psychological thoughts.

test_cases.query: Did an emergency ambulance or stray cattle block the ego-vehicle at 00:45 in this scene?
test_cases.description: Evaluates abstention on out-of-domain and non-existent queries.

test_cases.query: What was the ego-vehicle speed and heading in the genuine TIAND Hyderabad corridor around 00:05?
test_cases.description: Factual retrieval of genuine TIAND NovAtel OEM7 GNSS measurements.
